subject.title: Allow owners and authors to delete messages

question: Should workspace owners permanently receive soft-delete authority over messages authored by other users in workspace channels and threads, while direct messages remain author-only?
rationale: The implementation is technically bounded and tested, but expanding who may perform a destructive action is a product and authorization-policy decision that code review cannot safely infer.

options.title: Approve the current boundary
options.body: Accept owner moderation for channels and threads with the tested author-only DM exception and merge after required checks complete.

options.title: Keep deletion author-only
options.body: Remove owner deletion authority while retaining the new self-delete controls and confirmation flow.

options.title: Defer broader moderation
options.body: Pause this PR until a more complete moderation and audit policy is defined.

recommendation.title: Approve the current boundary
recommendation.body: Accept owner moderation for channels and threads with the tested author-only DM exception and merge after required checks complete.
